Warehouse Review 2026
Summary
The northern depot shipped more pallets than planned, and the southern depot cut its waiting times.
Inventory
Each site keeps a safety stock sized from the forecast of the coming weeks.
Counts
Forecast accuracy improved after the weekly review moved to Monday.
Stock counts are reconciled every Friday afternoon.
Checks
Check the loading bays.
Check the fire exits.
Plan
Order the new racks.
Train the night shift.
Owner: 
Due: 
See the Summary section and the Counts section for the figures.
The schedule lives on the planning site.
Suggested style: this line may become a heading.
Suggested bold: the forklift needs a service.
Suggested join: this paragraph
ends in the next one.
Appendix follows.
Appendix
Figures by site.
Measured over the last twelve weeks.
